The default worker command cannot finish a ticket headlessly: claude -p with acceptEdits is asked to approve git and kahnban commands. Allow the commands each role needs (allowedTools or project permission rules written by skills install) and prove it with the live test
tickets.description: A headless `claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits` worker is asked to approve `git add`, `git commit` and `kahnban approve`, and a headless worker cannot answer. Two live runs with Haiku (2026-10-25) show it: the first coder finished its work and could not commit it; with git allowed by name the second got through refine, implement and verify, and the reviewer then never ran `kahnban approve` or `kahnban reject`.

tickets.title: A SKILL.md without frontmatter lists with an empty description
tickets.description: `skills._read_skill_description` swallows the error that a `SKILL.md` without frontmatter raises, so `kahnban skills list` shows such a skill with an empty description although the file has a heading or a first line that would do. Found by the coverage work on `skills.py`; `tests/test_skills_sources.py` records the empty result today.
